files.item: Off With Their Heads: Assassins, Plots & Regicide 2008 programme.
files.notes: This is the printed programme from Off With Their Heads: Assassins, Plots & Regicide, the autumn series of events from 2008. The cover is adapted from an illustration in Danse macabre, ou l'Empire de la Mort, published by Antoine Vérard (active 1485‐1512) in the 1490s. The frame on the back is adapted from a theater ticket designed by William Hogarth (1697–1764), for a performance of William Congreve's (1670–1729) 'Old Batchelor' [sic] in 1738, which was a benefit for actor Joe Miller (1684–1738).

files.item: A flyer for Robbing Banks Is An Honour To Me, an event from Off With Their Heads: Assassins, Plots & Regicide 2008.
files.notes: Lucio Urtubia (1931–2020) was an anarchist, bank robber and forger. He is notorious for forging Citibank traveler's cheques to fund guerrilla groups.

files.item: A flyer for the gigs put on as part of Off With Their Heads: Assassins, Plots & Regicide 2008
files.notes: The character of Death is from 'Death on the Barricade', part of The Dance of Death by Alfred Rethel (1816–1859), 1849.
